name: Transaction List with Splits
description: Returns a detailed list of transactions with their split line details from the QuickBooks Online Report Service.

parameters.name: docnum
parameters.description: Filters report contents to include information for specified transaction number, as found in the docnum parameter of the transaction object.

parameters.name: name
parameters.description: Filters report contents based on the specified comma separated list of ids for the name list customer, vendor, or employee objects. Specify values found in Customer.Id, Vendor.Id, and Employee.Id. For example, name=1,4,7 includes data in the report for namelist ids 1, 4, and 7.

parameters.name: end_date
parameters.description: The end date of the report, in the format YYYY-MM-DD. start_date must be less than end_date. Use if you want the report to cover an explicit date range; otherwise, use date_macro to cover a standard report date range. If not specified value of date_macro is used.

parameters.name: date_macro
parameters.description: Predefined date range. Use if you want the report to cover a standard report date range; otherwise, use the start_date and end_date to cover an explicit report date range.

parameters.name: payment_method
parameters.description: Filters report contents based on payment method.

parameters.name: source_account_type
parameters.description: Account type from which transactions are included in the report.

parameters.name: transaction_type
parameters.description: Filters report contents based transaction type.

parameters.name: group_by
parameters.description: The field in the transaction by which to group results.

parameters.name: sort_by
parameters.description: The column type used in sorting report rows. Specify a column type as defined with the columns query parameter.

parameters.name: start_date
parameters.description: The start date of the report, in the format YYYY-MM-DD. start_date must be less than end_date. Use if you want the report to cover an explicit date range; otherwise, use date_macro to cover a standard report date range. If not specified value of date_macro is used.

parameters.name: columns
parameters.description: Column types to be shown in the report. Supported Values: tx_date, txn_type, doc_num, is_no_post, account_name, memo, amount, is_adj, create_by, create_date, last_mod_date, last_mod_by, cust_name, vend_name, rate, quantity, item_name, emp_name, pmt_mthd, nat_open_bal, tax_type, is_billable, debt_amt, credit_amt, is_cleared, olb_status. Additional columns with location tracking enabled: dept_name. Multicurrency is enabled for the company if Preferences.MultiCurrencyEnabled is set to true.
